title: Log-canonical threefold abundance in numerical dimension one

result.label: Log-canonical threefold abundance in numerical dimension one
result.statement: Proves log abundance for projective log canonical threefold pairs over algebraically closed fields of characteristic p > 3 when the effective boundary is rational and the ℚ-Cartier adjoint is nef of numerical dimension one. The adjoint is semiample, without requiring the original variety to be terminal or ℚ-factorial.
